method: Original bytes of all 204 ASM_EXACT owners without a DOS-FM pair (layout/manifest.json minus evidence/modules.json pairs) decoded with the pinned Capstone 5.0.3 (tools/disasm.py). Each marker was calibrated against all 567 accepted MSC 6.00 CODE_EXACT components in the same image: a marker is counted as strong only if it occurs in 0 of the 567 C components (exceptions noted). Strong markers: odd entry address (all 567 C entries are even); pop si/di/ds/es directly before pop bp (MSC restores through mov sp,bp); pop bp without mov sp,bp after a Pascal call (255/256 C functions comply, the exception is a call-free path); add sp,-n frame allocation (C uses sub sp,n 181 times); les/lds into ax/cx/dx; mov r,es; or ax,bx null tests; jcxz/loop/xlat/lods/stos/scas/cmps (lone); cli/sti/pushf/popf/in/out/int/iret/std/stc/clc/rcr; xor r,r zeroing (MSC uses sub r,r); test r,r (MSC uses or r,r); plain E8 near calls without push cs and near RET (register-argument helpers); mov bp,[bp+n]/BP as a general register; xchg other than MSC's xchg bx,ax; lea [bp..]; push ds (MSC pushes ss); carry-flag results tested after calls; frameless mov bx,sp argument access; jmp word ptr [DGROUP vector] stubs; far tail jumps. Weak markers (seen in C too: push es, cmc, CS: switch tables, mov ds,r) are listed only as supplements. MSC-like frames (push bp; mov bp,sp; push di; push si; retf n) were not taken as C evidence because FM-confirmed genuine assembly (UNPACK.ASM, TGATOMCG.ASM, XLATTXT4.ASM) uses the same frame shape.
